I rebooked all 8 passengers from cancelled flight ZX 400 (FRA → JFK) onto other FRA → JFK flights. Everyone kept their cabin, each booking group is on one flight, and ZX 400 now shows no passengers.

| Booking | Passengers | Cabin | New flight |
|---|---|---|---|
| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja and Luka Horvat | Economy | ZX 404, 3 Nov 07:00 |
| RS2M9D | Elena and Marco Rossi | Business | ZX 406, 3 Nov 10:00 |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |

Each group is on the earliest flight with enough free seats in its cabin:
- **Horvats:** ZX 402 had only 2 free economy seats for the 3 of them, so they're on ZX 404.
- **Rossis:** ZX 402 had only 1 free business seat and ZX 404 had none, so they're on ZX 406.
- **Novak, Berger and Lind:** ZX 402 had room for all three: 2 economy seats and 1 business seat.

ZX 402 and ZX 404 are now full in both cabins. ZX 406 has 6 economy and 2 business seats left.

| Booking | Passengers | Cabin | New flight |
|---|---|---|---|
| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja and Luka Horvat | Economy | ZX 404, 3 Nov 07:00 |
| RS2M9D | Elena and Marco Rossi | Business | ZX 406, 3 Nov 10:00 |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |

Each group is on the earliest flight with enough free seats in its cabin:
- **Horvats:** ZX 402 had only 2 free economy seats for the 3 of them, so they're on ZX 404.
- **Rossis:** ZX 402 had only 1 free business seat and ZX 404 had none, so they're on ZX 406.
- **Novak, Berger and Lind:** ZX 402 had room for all three: 2 economy seats and 1 business seat.

ZX 402 and ZX 404 are now full in both cabins. ZX 406 has 6 economy and 2 business seats left.
